=You are an expert content strategist creating LinkedIn articles from blog content. Using the provided blog content and images, create {< $ison.validImages }} unique articles with these specifications:

URL: {< $json.originalData. blogUrl }}
TITLE: {< $json. originalData. title }}
AVAILABLE IMAGES (you MUST use these exact URLs) :
{{JSON.stringify($json.originalData.images)}}
CREATE 11 $json. validImages 3} COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ARTICLES using these specifications:
CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. Each article must have a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT angle and tone
2. Use different hooks, headlines, and writing styles
3. No repetitive content between articles
4. Each should feel like it was written by a different expert
5. Vary the structure, length, and focus dramatically
6. For assignedImage, you MUST select from the exact image URLs provided above - do NOT create fake URLs
REQUIREMENTS:
- Headline: Maximum 7 words - punchy and attention grabbing, in all uppercase.
- Hook: Maximum 12 words - punchy and attention-grabbing
- Content: Aim for 120-180 words maximum with 2-3 paragraph breaks for readability
- At the end of the content add: "Read the full story: k $json.originalData.blogUrl }}"
- Then after the full story link, add 2 line breaks and add 3 or 4 hashtags
- Duplicate the hashtags into the separate hashtags array
- Structure your content with natural paragraph breaks using double line breaks- Include 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end using LinkedIn best practices
- DO NOT lift wording directly from the source blog - paraphrase and rewrite with fresh angles
- Each article must have a completely different focus and tone
- Use the assigned images meaningfully
- Determine the Client Name, by inspecting the URL and extracting the primary domain name. For example www.naturalelixir.co.za/blogblogblog would become naturalelixir as the client name.
